transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this case conference as part of our pre-filing practice before we make a decision on seeking a preliminary injunction. As you all know, a former sales executive left last week and joined a direct competitor, and we believe confidential customer information may have been used after their departure. We could request an injunction hearing within three weeks. Our draft filing currently seeks broad relief covering customer information, pricing materials, and source-code documentation. Before I authorize anything, I need each of you to report any material issues on your end. Let's start with employment counsel -- are there any concerns from the employment side? Forensics, what do we have? And insurance counsel, anything we need to know about coverage?
